messages.subject: [Fedora-r-devel-list] R 2.6.2 on F-7 and F-8

https://admin.fedoraproject.org/updates/F8/pending/rpy-1.0.1-3.fc8,R-2.6.2-1.fc8.1

Thanks,

~spot
